replacements.find:
• Dried beans: roughly 15g protein per cooked cup. The cheapest protein in the store, hands down.
  • Dried lentils: ~$1.92 a pound dry, roughly 18g protein per cooked cup. Cook in 20 minutes with no soaking.
  • Eggs: ~$0.14 an egg, 12g protein for two large eggs. Prices swing, but still a bargain.
  • Milk: ~$2.75 a gallon, 8g protein per cup. Cheap protein you can drink.
  • Peanut butter: ~$1.38 a pound, 7g protein per 2-tablespoon serving. Fat and protein together, shelf-stable forever.
  • Canned tuna: ~$2.66 a pound, 20g protein per can. Ready to eat, no cooking, long shelf life.
  • Chicken (bone-in thighs or whole bird): a whole bird runs ~$1.32 a pound, 25g protein per 4 ounces. Buy it on the bone and skin-on to save the most.
  • Greek yogurt (large tub): ~$2.24 a pound, 17g protein per two-thirds cup. Buy the tub, never the little cups.
  • Cottage cheese: ~$1.82 a pound, 24g protein per cup. Quietly one of the best deals going.
  • Ground turkey: ~$2.66 a pound, 22g protein per 4 ounces. Lean and easy to stretch.
